facts.fact: Eswatini's ICT minister said at the opening of a joint ministry and Smart Africa workshop on 7 October 2026 that Eswatini and The Gambia had been selected as the two pilot countries for Smart Africa's gender impact assessment tools for digital policy; the workshop itself was held in Eswatini and the article does not say The Gambia took part in it.

systems.system: Gender Impact Assessment Tool, Gender Policy Review Tool and Gender Budgeting Tool
systems.tiers: Eswatini and The Gambia as pilot countries
